paidOutFormula: 19,277 − 4,351 + 263 (PP&E + intangibles, combined line) = 15,189 USD million (taxes paid inside OCF; no cash interest-paid line)
notes: IFRS, USD (Form 20-F; the Indian annual report uses INR). Income taxes paid (net) sit in operating. 'Interest and dividend received' (113) sit in investing, so OCF is not inflated by them. No cash interest-paid line exists, so interestPaid is null; the accrued lease finance cost (40), settled through financing lease payments, is recorded as context and not added (adding it would give 15.229). Taxes paid (662) are net of 821 of refunds for earlier years received in FY2025, which lifts OCF and lowers paidOut for this year by roughly that amount (not adjusted).
